pages.text: $(l)Reiko's Car Mod$() adds over thirty drivable cars, trucks and motorcycles, and trailers to tow behind them. They run on $(thing)BuildCraft Reborn$() fuels (or its MJ, for the electric ones), and everything you buy is paid in $(thing)Reiko's Economy Mod$() money, by card or cash.
Cars wear out, get dirty, need keys, fuel and insurance, and earn their keep.

This book has a chapter for each part of the mod. Start with $(l:getting_started/first_car)Your First Car$(/l), then look things up as you need them.$(br2)Most blocks in this mod belong to whoever puts them down: only they (or an admin) can break them, and they set the prices and keep the money.
Lost this book? Make another from a book and an iron ingot, or open it from the Car Workbench's Guide button.
